title: Minimal accessible directory view rendering the pilot from published exports
context: The directory/map view is a thin reference consumer of the published HSDS/GeoJSON exports. It is deliberately minimal at M0 — just enough to render the pilot entries so that a food-insecure person can browse them. It must be statically hosted, accessible (targeting WCAG 2.2 AA), and include no third-party trackers. Every entry must surface the last_verified date and a 'call ahead' caveat so users are never over-reliant on possibly-stale data. Depends on food-maps-pilot-004 (pilot dataset) and food-maps-ci-005 (CI gates).
objective: Build a minimal static directory view (chosen technology per ADR in food-maps-arch-002) that reads the published GeoJSON/HSDS exports and renders the pilot entries as a browsable list (and optionally a map). The view must: show name, address, hours, service type, eligibility summary, languages served, accessibility info, and last_verified + 'call ahead / verify before visiting' caveat for every entry; be deployable as a static site; include no telemetry or third-party trackers; and pass automated axe/pa11y checks at WCAG 2.2 AA.
acceptanceCriteria: View renders all pilot entries from the published HSDS/GeoJSON export without fetching data at runtime (static build)

Every entry displays: name, address, hours, service type, eligibility summary, languages served, accessibility info, last_verified date, and operating_status (with 'call ahead' caveat where not 'open')
No third-party tracker scripts, analytics, or ad-network resources are loaded (enforced by CSP and verified by the CI no-tracker E2E)
Automated axe/pa11y scan produces 0 critical WCAG 2.2 AA violations
Site is keyboard-navigable (all interactive elements reachable and operable via keyboard)
Static build can be deployed to a standard static hosting service (e.g., GitHub Pages, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages)
Credits/sources page lists all data sources with correct attribution (including OSM '© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL' if OSM data is present)
All pilot entries are visible and the view degrades gracefully if the export is empty
output: src/view/ (static front-end source) + built output in dist/ that passes CI (axe, no-tracker E2E, CSP).
